messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

The GO requests the measurements to the MSP. The MSP checks the received request. The MSP denies the request of the GO or the MSP performs the measurement. The MSP informs the GO about the failure of the reading or the MSP transmits the measured values to the GO. The GO processes the measured values. The GO sends the changed values to the MSP. The GO transmit the readings to the SP.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
             xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI"
             xmlns:omgdc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC"
             xmlns:omgdi="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI"
             id="Definitions_1"
             targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">

  <collaboration id="Collaboration_1">
    <participant id="Participant_GO" name="Grid Operator (GO)" processRef="Process_GO"/>
    <participant id="Participant_MSP" name="Metering Service Provider (MSP)" processRef="Process_MSP"/>
    <participant id="Participant_SP" name="Service Provider (SP)"/>

    <messageFlow id="MF_Request" name="Measurement Request"
                 sourceRef="Task_RequestMeasurements" targetRef="StartEvent_MSP"/>
    <messageFlow id="MF_Denial" name="Denial Notification"
                 sourceRef="Task_DenyRequest" targetRef="Event_ReceiveFailure"/>
    <messageFlow id="MF_Failure" name="Failure Notification"
                 sourceRef="Task_InformFailure" targetRef="Event_ReceiveFailure"/>
    <messageFlow id="MF_MeasuredValues" name="Measured Values"
                 sourceRef="Task_TransmitValues" targetRef="Event_ReceiveValues"/>
    <messageFlow id="MF_ChangedValues" name="Changed Values"
                 sourceRef="Task_SendChangedValues" targetRef="Event_ReceiveChangedValues"/>
    <messageFlow id="MF_Readings" name="Readings"
                 sourceRef="Task_TransmitReadings" targetRef="Participant_SP"/>
  </collaboration>

  <!-- ============== GO PROCESS ============== -->
  <process id="Process_GO" name="GO Process" isExecutable="false">

    <startEvent id="StartEvent_GO" name="Start">
      <outgoing>SF_GO_1</outgoing>
    </startEvent>

    <sendTask id="Task_RequestMeasurements" name="Request Measurements">
      <incoming>SF_GO_1</incoming>
      <outgoing>SF_GO_2</outgoing>
    </sendTask>

    <eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_EG1" name="Wait for MSP Response">
      <incoming>SF_GO_2</incoming>
      <outgoing>SF_GO_3</outgoing>
      <outgoing>SF_GO_4</outgoing>
    </eventBasedGateway>

    <intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveFailure" name="Receive Failure/Denial">
      <incoming>SF_GO_3</incoming>
      <outgoing>SF_GO_5</outgoing>
      <messageEventDefinition id="MsgDef_Failure"/>
    </intermediateCatchEvent>

    <intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveValues" name="Receive Measured Values">
      <incoming>SF_GO_4</incoming>
      <outgoing>SF_GO_6</outgoing>
      <messageEventDefinition id="MsgDef_Values"/>
    </intermediateCatchEvent>

    <endEvent id="EndEvent_Failed" name="Process Failed">
      <incoming>SF_GO_5</incoming>
    </endEvent>

    <task id="Task_ProcessValues" name="Process Measured Values">
      <incoming>SF_GO_6</incoming>
      <outgoing>SF_GO_7</outgoing>
    </task>

    <sendTask id="Task_SendChangedValues" name="Send Changed Values">
      <incoming>SF_GO_7</incoming>
      <outgoing>SF_GO_8</outgoing>
    </sendTask>

    <sendTask id="Task_TransmitReadings" name="Transmit Readings to SP">
      <incoming>SF_GO_8</incoming>
      <outgoing>SF_GO_9</outgoing>
    </sendTask>

    <endEvent id="EndEvent_Completed" name="Process Completed">
      <incoming>SF_GO_9</incoming>
    </endEvent>

    <sequenceFlow id="SF_GO_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_GO" targetRef="Task_RequestMeasurements"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="SF_GO_2" sourceRef="Task_RequestMeasurements" targetRef="Gateway_EG1"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="SF_GO_3" sourceRef="Gateway_EG1" targetRef="Event_ReceiveFailure"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="SF_GO_4" sourceRef="Gateway_EG1" targetRef="Event_ReceiveValues"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="SF_GO_5" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveFailure" targetRef="EndEvent_Failed"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="SF_GO_6" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveValues" targetRef="Task_ProcessValues"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="SF_GO_7" sourceRef="Task_ProcessValues" targetRef="Task_SendChangedValues"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="SF_GO_8" sourceRef="Task_SendChangedValues" targetRef="Task_TransmitReadings"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="SF_GO_9" sourceRef="Task_TransmitReadings" targetRef="EndEvent_Completed"/>

  </process>

  <!-- ============== MSP PROCESS ============== -->
  <process id="Process_MSP" name="MSP Process" isExecutable="false">

    <startEvent id="StartEvent_MSP" name="Receive Request">
      <outgoing>SF_MSP_1</outgoing>
      <messageEventDefinition id="MsgDef_Request"/>
    </startEvent>

    <task id="Task_CheckRequest" name="Check Received Request">
      <incoming>SF_MSP_1</incoming>
      <outgoing>SF_MSP_2</outgoing>
    </task>

    <exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Decision1" name="Deny or Perform?">
      <incoming>SF_MSP_2</incoming>
      <outgoing>SF_MSP_3</outgoing>
      <outgoing>SF_MSP_4</outgoing>
    </exclusiveGateway>

    <sendTask id="Task_DenyRequest" name="Deny Request">
      <incoming>SF_MSP_3</incoming>
      <outgoing>SF_MSP_5</outgoing>
    </sendTask>

    <endEvent id="EndEvent_Denied" name="Request Denied">
      <incoming>SF_MSP_5</incoming>
    </endEvent>

    <task id="Task_PerformMeasurement" name="Perform Measurement">
      <incoming>SF_MSP_4</incoming>
      <outgoing>SF_MSP_6</outgoing>
    </task>

    <exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Decision2" name="Success or Failure?">
      <incoming>SF_MSP_6</incoming>
      <outgoing>SF_MSP_7</outgoing>
      <outgoing>SF_MSP_8</outgoing>
    </exclusiveGateway>

    <sendTask id="Task_InformFailure" name="Inform Failure of Reading">
      <incoming>SF_MSP_7</incoming>
      <outgoing>SF_MSP_9</outgoing>
    </sendTask>

    <endEvent id="EndEvent_MeasurementFailed" name="Measurement Failed">
      <incoming>SF_MSP_9</incoming>
    </endEvent>

    <sendTask id="Task_TransmitValues" name="Transmit Measured Values">
      <incoming>SF_MSP_8</incoming>
      <outgoing>SF_MSP_10</outgoing>
    </sendTask>

    <intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveChangedValues" name="Receive Changed Values">
      <incoming>SF_MSP_10</incoming>
      <outgoing>SF_MSP_11</outgoing>
      <messageEventDefinition id="MsgDef_ChangedValues"/>
    </intermediateCatchEvent>

    <endEvent id="EndEvent_MSPCompleted" name="Completed">
      <incoming>SF_MSP_11</incoming>
    </endEvent>

    <sequenceFlow id="SF_MSP_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_MSP" targetRef="Task_CheckRequest"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="SF_MSP_2" sourceRef="Task_CheckRequest" targetRef="Gateway_Decision1"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="SF_MSP_3" name="Deny" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision1" targetRef="Task_DenyRequest"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="SF_MSP_4" name="Perform" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision1" targetRef="Task_PerformMeasurement"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="SF_MSP_5" sourceRef="Task_DenyRequest" targetRef="EndEvent_Denied"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="SF_MSP_6" sourceRef="Task_PerformMeasurement" targetRef="Gateway_Decision2"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="SF_MSP_7" name="Failure" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision2" targetRef="Task_InformFailure"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="SF_MSP_8" name="Success" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision2" targetRef="Task_TransmitValues"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="SF_MSP_9" sourceRef="Task_InformFailure" targetRef="EndEvent_MeasurementFailed"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="SF_MSP_10" sourceRef="Task_TransmitValues" targetRef="Event_ReceiveChangedValues"/>
    <sequenceFlow id="SF_MSP_11" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveChangedValues" targetRef="EndEvent_MSPCompleted"/>

  </process>

</definitions>
